cases.prompt: Listen to this single audio clip. Is music present? What is the main perceived source of rhythmic motion: moving melody, repeated percussive attacks, both, unclear, or no music? Does the clip develop or predominantly repeat: develops, repeats, unclear, or no music? Report what you hear, without identifying a source or ranking quality. Return only JSON with music_present (yes/no/unclear), rhythmic_motion (moving melody/repeated percussive attacks/both/unclear/no music), development (develops/repeats/unclear/no music), and evidence (one or two short objects containing start_seconds, end_seconds, and observation). Times are relative to the clip and must lie within it. Use unclear when you cannot tell.
